The '''DL44 Metal Pistol''', also stylized as the '''DL 44 Metal Pistol''', was a type of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] used during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It was a lighter version of the [[DL-44 XT]], and was similar in design to the [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]].

This blaster served as the lighter version of the [[DL-44 XT]]. Both were [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] which closely resembled the [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]]. However, unlike a typical DL-44 [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], the DL44 Metal Pistol featured a metal housing with a [[chrome]] finish. Furthermore, unlike the upgraded DL-44 XT version, the lighter DL44 Metal Pistol lacked some of the balancing weights, and it typically lacked the larger [[Scope/Legends|scope]] and [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] attachments.<ref name="AED" />
